findings.title: Ordinary text history is not transformed or invalidated by remote edits/reorders
findings.cause: History invalidation only covers tables and Mermaid. Ordinary paragraph history keeps old paths and full delta snapshots, while underlying remote apply adjusts only the live selection.

reproductions.setup: p:ab -> local insert X -> p:aXb -> remote prepend Z -> p:ZaXb -> undo
p:ab,q:cd -> local insert X into p -> remote reorder q:cd,p:aXb -> undo

findings.recommendation: Transform local undo/redo against remote text/tree operations, or invalidate affected history before replay until a safe transformation exists.

findings.title: Paragraph property-only edits are dropped by controller snapshot equality
findings.cause: _rustBlocksEqual omits paragraphStyle. Both local write deduplication and remote projection use this comparison.

reproductions.setup: Real editable formal controller plus basic fixture; call setCollabNextParagraphStyle(state, same)
reproductions.expected: Authoritative native paragraphStyle contains nextParagraphStyle:same; nonempty V1 diff
reproductions.actual: UI wrapper changes to same; native paragraphStyle stays null and V1 diff is [0,0]

findings.recommendation: Include paragraph property values and applicable explicit mutation intent in controller comparison, and test the real controller rather than only adapter/native direct paths.

findings.title: Inline metadata-only edits are dropped by controller segment equality
findings.cause: _rustSegmentsEqual omits typography, href, inlineLatex, inlineMention, mentionId/type/attributes. Same text/style flags/segment boundaries are considered equal.

reproductions.setup: Real formal controller basic first paragraph; format the entire existing segment with t:px:28
reproductions.expected: New typography persists and produces V1 update
reproductions.actual: UI t:px changes; native remains serif-only and V1 diff is [0,0]

reproductions.setup: Same controller fixture; change only the existing full-segment href
reproductions.expected: New href persists and produces V1 update
reproductions.actual: UI href changes to review.example; native keeps example.test and V1 diff is [0,0]

findings.recommendation: Compare all segment fields or delegate to a complete immutable snapshot equality; cover unchanged-length formula edits and remote metadata projection as well.

findings.title: Persistence failure leaves live Yrs state ahead of the recoverable log
findings.cause: Local and remote paths commit the authoritative Doc before SQLite insert. A failed insert has no rollback or later retry of the missing update, so later successful updates may depend on unpersisted Yrs structs.

reproductions.setup: Temporary copy of crate/private engine with isolated SQLite: persist A; inject BEFORE INSERT trigger that fails writes; attempt AB and receive error; remove trigger; successfully apply ABC; reopen database
reproductions.expected: Successful final edit reopens as ABC
reproductions.actual: Failed operation leaves live Doc=AB; reopening after successful ABC restores only A

findings.recommendation: Stage mutation and make persistence durable before advancing the live Doc, or explicitly recover/retain the failed update and block later dependent writes until storage consistency is restored.

findings.title: A failed permission-session transition poisons future transitions and skips close cleanup
findings.cause: _accessTransition chains only success handlers. A register failure keeps it rejected. _shutdown awaits that rejected Future before _releaseSession, so its catch bypasses cleanup of the newly created session listener.

reproductions.setup: Initialize real controller with fake borrowed gateway; reject one registration during setEditable(false); retry setEditable(true)
reproductions.expected: Next transition registers a new session after the transient failure
reproductions.actual: Next transition rethrows the previous failure without calling register

reproductions.setup: Same registration failure followed by await controller.close()
reproductions.expected: Borrowed gateway event stream has no document-session listeners

findings.recommendation: Recover the internal transition queue while reporting each operation failure, dispose partially started sessions, and always run session cleanup even when an earlier awaited task fails.
